604:t_7:56.en:
$$シン$$
「Fine by me. That's exactly what we intended too.」

604:t_7:57.en:
$$葵$$
「So it's finally time for the decisive battle with the Empire.」

604:t_7:58.en:
$$タケル$$
「We've been fighting for this moment.」

604:t_7:59.en:
$$カレン$$
「Things are tough right after your return, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

604:t_7:60.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's all right. I'll work hard to make up for all the time I've spent resting.」

604:t_7:62.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Maybe it's because I've got enough spirit for two.」

604:t_7:63.en:
$$宗介$$
「Do you mean $$アムブリエル$$?」

604:t_7:64.en:
$$スズネ$$
「She was my other self, and we tried to erase each other's existence...」

604:t_7:65.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But she was part of me too... When $n said he'd save us both, we came to understand that.」

604:t_7:66.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That's why we were able to become one.」

604:t_7:67.en:
$$アルト$$
「Lieutenant $$カナリア$$ said that with ordinary dual personalities, one eventually vanishes. But in your case, Miss $$スズネ$$, they merged.」

604:t_7:68.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I think that's thanks to $n overcoming his conflicting emotions too.」

604:t_7:70.en:
$$宗介$$
「He's gone off alone. He said he wanted to gather his thoughts.」

604:t_7:71.en:
$$カレン$$
「He's off alone even though Miss $$スズネ$$ has finally come back?」

604:t_7:74.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's not inconceivable. I know what it's like for both people's feelings to reach extraordinary heights when they reunite.」

604:t_7:76.en:
$$アルト$$
「Well, he's probably tired too. A lot's happened one thing after another.」

604:t_7:77.en:
$$甲児$$
「It started with the secret of $$ラプラスの箱$$, then $$クロノ$$'s doctrine... our confrontation with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$...」

604:t_7:78.en:
$$アルト$$
「Then $$アサキム$$ broke with $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, and on top of that, $$ガドライト#pilot$$ was still alive...」

604:t_7:79.en:
$$スズネ$$
「And $n brought out a new power in $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ too.」

604:t_7:80.en:
$$カレン$$
「Was that the power of your love?」

604:t_7:81.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'd be happy if it was.」

604:t_7:82.en:
$$甲児$$
「S-somehow, Miss $$スズネ$$... You really have changed a little...」

604:t_7:83.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Yeah. Before, whenever we brought up this sort of thing, she'd either deny it with all her might or dodge the question...」

604:t_7:85.en:
$$カレン$$
「Do you mean $$アムブリエル$$'s influence?」

604:t_7:86.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes. Until now, I worried too much about my role: being a teacher, being older, all of that.」

604:t_7:87.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But coming into contact with her desire for freedom made me want to show more of my true self too.」

604:t_7:88.en:
$$アルト$$
「Is that why you're wearing glasses with your new pilot suit...?」

604:t_7:89.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Maybe so. The truth is... I like myself better with glasses.」

604:t_7:90.en:
$$スズネ$$
「When I discovered my other self, I was frightened and repulsed, but now I can accept her...」

604:t_7:91.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I think that's thanks to fighting alongside $n too.」

604:t_7:92.en:
$$かなめ$$
「You should be telling $n that, not us.」

604:t_7:93.en:
$$スズネ$$
「You're right. ...I'll go see him, then.」

604:t_7:94.en:
$$甲児$$
「She really is taking the initiative!」

604:t_7:95.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Has $$アムブリエル$$ come back out again...?」

604:t_7:96.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「No... Miss $$スズネ$$ is just being honest with herself.」

604:t_7:97.en:
$$カレン$$
「Exactly. She hasn't changed at all on the inside.」

604:t_7:98.en:
$$アルト$$
「It means a lot to have Miss $$スズネ$$ back before the big showdown ahead.」

604:t_7:99.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah... Now we know $$サイデリアル$$ is an even stronger enemy than we imagined. We need to steel ourselves too.」

604:t_7:100.en:
$$宗介$$
「They have controlled humanity's evolution in various parallel worlds for centuries...」

604:t_7:101.en:
$$アルト$$
「Unless we defeat them, humanity can't move into the future...」

604:t_7:102.en:
$$甲児$$
「Just you wait, Emperor $$アウストラリス$$... If that's what you want, we'll come storming into $$ラース・バビロン$$.」

604:t_7:107.en:
$n
「...So you've made peace with $$アムブリエル$$.」

604:t_7:108.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes... She and I have merged, and we coexist in this body.」

604:t_7:109.en:
$n
「But I'm so glad... that you've come back, Miss $$スズネ$$...」

604:t_7:110.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm glad I could come back too... That I can be here with you again, $n...」

604:t_7:113.en:
$n
「...There's so much I want to talk about. $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$, $$マキ#pilot$$, $$ティティ$$...」

604:t_7:115.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I understand. First, give your body a good rest.」

604:t_7:116.en:
$$スズネ$$
「I'll come back at dinnertime. You should get some sleep until then.」

604:t_7:123.en:
$n
(Back then, I definitely saw Miss $$スズネ$$ die...)

604:t_7:124.en:
$n
(At that moment, I rejected what had happened in front of me... And reality changed just as I wished.)

604:t_7:125.en:
$n
(Judging by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and $$アサキム$$'s reactions too, time definitely rewound a little...)

604:t_7:126.en:
$n
(At that moment, I felt all twelve $$スフィア$$s...)

604:t_7:127.en:
$n
(I'd heard that gathering multiple $$スフィア$$s brought out more power than a single one, but...)

604:t_7:128.en:
$n
(If all twelve $$スフィア$$s come together, can they even change things that have already happened...?)

604:t_7:129.en:
$n
(But using that kind of power can't be right... If something like that existed, the world would be thrown into chaos...)

604:t_7:130.en:
$n
(If someone could use it without doubt or hesitation, that would be...)

604:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. As our proprietor $$ＡＧ$$ is absent today, $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will operate through our automated shopkeeping service.」

604:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Please note that celebrations for ace pilots will be postponed until another occasion.」

604:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Now, please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」

605:t_000:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「Now that $$クロノ$$ knows we have obtained $$ラプラスの箱$$, they will send troops here.」

605:t_000:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We will defend $$メガラニカ$$ while Princess $$ミネバ$$ reveals the truth of the Box.」

605:t_000:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$クロノ$$'s enforcement unit has almost no fighting strength left. The Imperial Army will probably move too.」
